trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no extra task hiding behind it. It is the last trophy by definition, and it arrives after the story, the 100% checklist, the Strangers & Freaks strands and the miscellaneous cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole journey 4/10 for difficulty and about 200 hours: the cost is time, not skill, and almost nothing in it demands a perfect run. Work through the three stages in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then strangers and leftovers — and keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter, because there is no mission replay. The only thing that can genuinely go wrong is the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, so do that before leaving Chapter 1.
steps: Play the story through all five chapters (Stage 1).
After the credits, clear the 100% Completion checklist for A Long Road (Stage 2).
Finish the Strangers & Freaks strands and sweep up any leftover trophies (Stage 3).
The platinum pops as soon as the 54th other trophy does.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks on its own when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1 — it will be one of the first trophies you earn, and you cannot miss it by playing normally. Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so there is no preparation and no side requirement; just follow the story prompts. If it has not popped, you have not finished the mission yet — check that the mission-complete screen appeared.
steps: Start the story and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it pops as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins — so play through Chapter 1 and it is yours. Before you leave the chapter, though, do the morning balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude): it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that may never come back, and Chapter 1 is the only place to get it. Also worth doing while you are here: meet Cal in Feng Shui, which starts the fishing questline, and answer Kenton's call after Island Dreams to start his treasure diving.
steps: Finish every Chapter 1 main mission, up to the start of What's in the Bag?.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do the morning balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house.
Optional while here: meet Cal in Feng Shui and answer Kenton's call after Island Dreams.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City, per PowerPyx — just play the main missions in order. Chapter 2 is a turning point for the rest of the run: the mission Coffee Break unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, which is what makes the partner trophies, the second-character meditations and the dual workouts possible at all. The chapter also opens the Thrillbilly Mudclub (Billy's questline), the Moses mission that unlocks the Scooter Bros app, and Daily Driver, which unlocks the garage properties.
steps: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission, up to the start of Welcome to Vice City.
After Coffee Break, note that you can now switch characters — this unlocks several later trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx says it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life — so keep playing into Chapter 4 and it will pop. Chapter 3 is busy with unlocks that feed the rest of the platinum: Credit Check opens bank jobs, payday loans and the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering Marked Bills, and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs opens jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun. It is also the chapter where Lucia's Andy questline, Randy's wish list and Tyrone's Synthetic Labs strand all begin, and where you can first register cars with trackers at Pay 'n' Spray.
steps: Finish every Chapter 3 main mission, then start Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach, Another Life).
While here, do Credit Check and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — they unlock bank jobs and jewelry robberies.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Per PowerPyx it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero — play the main missions through and it unlocks on its own. Chapter 4 is where the big-money optional mission That's Where The Money Is… appears and unlocks bank vault robberies, so do it when it shows up: vaults feed Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and the 100% checklist, and a single vault can pay up to $205,000. It is also the chapter of the named-mission trophies Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked.
steps: Finish every Chapter 4 main mission, up to Starting From Zero.
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it appears — it unlocks bank vault robberies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing the final mission — the story's ending, and the last chapter trophy. After the credits you return to free-roam, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats, and cheats unlock. Do not use cheats on your platinum save: they disable trophies and saving. From here the game opens up completely — every trophy that is not already earned can be worked on in free-roam, and the roadmap's Stage 2 begins with the checklist.
steps: Finish the story's final mission and watch the credits.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the Stage 2 checklist.
Do not turn on cheats on this save — they disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when you finish Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission. It is one of the named-mission trophies that unlock as you play the story in order, so there is nothing special to do and nothing to miss — no side objective, no timing, no choice that affects it. Just keep playing the main missions and it arrives on its own.
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when you finish The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. Like the other named-mission trophies it unlocks by playing the story in order, with no side requirement and nothing missable about it. Chapter 3 is a good place to start the habits that pay off later — scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study new animals with the binoculars — but this trophy itself needs nothing but the mission.
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when you finish Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. It unlocks by playing the story, with no side requirement — one of the named-mission trophies that simply arrive in order. Chapter 4 also holds the other two named-mission trophies of the chapter (Headliners and VCIA Takedown), so all three come from the same stretch of story.
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when you finish Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. It arrives by playing the story — no preparation, no missable step, no choice to get wrong. Headliners sits in the same Chapter 4 stretch as Child's Play and VCIA Takedown, so the three named-mission trophies of the chapter land close together.
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when you finish VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission. It unlocks in the course of the story, so just keep playing the main missions in order. The mission's airport setting is also a useful preview: VCIA is where the Catch Me If You Can plane theft happens later, so you will already know the layout when you come back for it.
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when you finish Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission. It is the last named-mission trophy before the finale, and it unlocks by playing the story — nothing to prepare, nothing to miss. After it, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy You Gotta Know When to Get Off, and then the free-roam cleanup begins.
steps: Play the story through the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set: finish the in-game 100% Completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the story. The good news, per PowerPyx, is that it is closer to 60% true completion — most requirements are partial (200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts), so you can skip the hardest slice of each. The only lines that demand everything are the robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults), 33 underwater discoveries, 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 Drone Time Trials and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Nothing for 100% is missable, and everything you did during the story already counts — so start the habits early (scan vehicles, study animals, do optional missions as they appear) and the checklist is mostly a matter of finishing what you started. The roadmap page of this guide lists every checklist line with its required number.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Clear every robbery line in full: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults.
Finish the all-or-nothing lines: 33 underwater discoveries, 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 Drone Time Trials, 15 Target Decks.
Top up the partial lines (vehicles, animals, cards, challenges, stunts) to their listed numbers — the easiest remaining ones first.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds, per PowerPyx: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps, and you can mix them freely — any 250 count. Under the Bridges are the quickest to rack up: take a plane and fly under bridge after bridge. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping at the pop. Track your counts under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or find the spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Stunt Jumps need a fast car and a good run-up; Base Jumps need height and a parachute, so save those for last.
steps: Open Progress > Activities > Stunts to see which categories you have done.
Do any 250 stunts across the four categories — Under the Bridges in a plane is fastest.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The trophy tracker counts them, and you can see them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. PowerPyx says you will do one of each almost automatically while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so do not chase it early — check the Activities screen late in the game and mop up whichever type is still at zero. The rarest stragglers are usually golf and pool, both of which have dedicated locations on the map.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you have done.
Do one of each type; the story and 100% work cover most of them.
Mop up the leftovers late — golf and pool are the usual stragglers.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the 12 shooting range locations. The 100% checklist also demands all 42, so this is a mandatory grind rather than a side quest — there is no way around it. PowerPyx links a full location guide for all 12 ranges; the medals themselves are not considered very hard, but accuracy and speed both matter, so replay a challenge until gold rather than settling for silver. Practising here also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, and the ranges are a good place to learn each weapon's handling. Work through them location by location and tick them off as you go.
steps: Visit all 12 Shooting Range locations (PowerPyx lists them all).
Gold all 42 challenges — accuracy and speed both matter, so replay until gold.
The same 42 golds are required for the 100% checklist, so this is not optional work.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. PowerPyx lists 42 drone races in total across those 14 spots, and the 100% checklist also wants all 42 Drone Time Trials completed — so plan to finish every drone event, not just one win per location, because the checklist will send you back anyway. Drone races are one of the few activity types the checklist demands in full. Learn the drone's handling at the first location before chasing wins: tight turns and low lines through the gates save more time than raw speed. A win at a location also counts toward the race activity type for Master of None.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun locations and win a drone race at each.
Complete all 42 Drone Time Trials as well — the 100% checklist demands them in full.
Learn the drone handling at the first location; tight lines through gates beat raw speed.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in total, per PowerPyx, and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won, plus 10 of 13 Race Challenge gold medals — so aim past 20 from the start and keep racing rather than stopping at the pop. Only wins at distinct locations count, so repeating the same easy race does not help. A well-tuned car matters more than raw aggression: pick a race, learn its corners, and upgrade the car for it. Races also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations — repeats of one race do not count.
Keep going to 30 wins and 10 Race Challenge gold medals for the 100% checklist.
Tune a car for the race you are running; learning the corners beats ramming rivals.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets — it is a contest of catches, so fish steadily and do not waste time on bad casts. The questline stays available after the story, so there is no rush and nothing missable here. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and a good rod and bait help if you have them.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text, follow the purple marker to the fishing spot.
Beat Cal in his fishing challenge — steady catches beat rushed casts.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are 4, per PowerPyx: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it, so pick whichever game you like best and learn its levels. The 100% checklist wants all 4 played, so you will come back for the other three anyway. Playing a video game also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Play any of the 4 arcade games to the end of its levels — challenges inside it are optional.
The first three are on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines.
The 100% checklist wants all 4 played, so finish the other three later.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Her questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. PowerPyx lists her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests are light, talky errands rather than combat, and all of them stay available after the story, so you can do them whenever you are playing as Lucia. Note that Andy does not count as a stranger for the Strangers & Freaks trophy — her strand is a named character questline.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3; answer Andy's call and follow her address in Belville.
Complete her five quests in order, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
If a quest is not showing, switch to Lucia — the strand is Lucia-only.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. His questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure in shipwrecks — 7 sets in total, marked with purple chest icons; use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring the finds back to him. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason; calling Brian can speed it up), so do not panic if he goes quiet. Track him under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. The 100% checklist wants 5 of his 7 sets, so you will be diving for him anyway.
steps: After Island Dreams (Chapter 1), answer Kenton's call and visit Key Lento.
Dive his marked shipwrecks with the metal detector and return the treasure, set by set.
If he goes unavailable after Chapter 1, keep playing — he returns in Chapters 2-3.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. PowerPyx lists his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests are driving- and biker-flavoured, and all of them stay available after the story, so there is no deadline. Like Andy, Billy does not count as a stranger for the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Billy's five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Not every side questline counts — PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers for this trophy, because they are named character questlines. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm and the chemical collections) and Yago (the street-race mentoring strand), plus Pilot Pete's delivery strand. Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see your count, and keep playing stranger strands until it reaches 8 — the tracker is the only reliable way to know which strands counted. Stranger strands appear as you explore, so work on them alongside the rest of Stage 3.
steps: Find stranger strands in the open world — they are not the named character questlines.
Complete 8 counting strands; Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Check the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count; keep going until it reads 8.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. His questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered: the Zorrusso plus 15 more (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D). Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if he wants one, then drive it to his garage in west Vice City. Delivering in good condition pays more, so drive carefully rather than fast. It can all be done after the story, and Randy does not count as a stranger for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Chapter 3) to unlock the Key Cloner and the wish list.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to check them against Randy's list.
Steal and deliver the 16 cars on the list to his garage in west Vice City, in good condition.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This — shutting down the labs — and the trophy pops when it is done. It all stays available after the story, so do it whenever you are playing as Jason. Tyrone does not count as a stranger for the Strangers & Freaks trophy.
steps: As Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs.
Destroy labs in Take Out Kitty Litter until Tyrone gives you Spin On This.
Finish Spin On This to shut the labs down and pop the trophy.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations, per PowerPyx. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, and you cannot do the last spot until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she talks about meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept. It raises the meditation counter by 1, though it is not marked as a spot like the others, and PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway, before leaving Chapter 1. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy wants all of them. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and meditate with both characters at each spot where you can.
steps: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept the balcony meditation.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), meditate at all 18 spots — with both characters at each spot where possible.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the checklist needs only 15, this trophy needs all 18.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is marked automatically some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County — it is Jason-only, Lucia cannot receive it. Meet Bret, and he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animal he requests and bring it back to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required for the trophy. There are 15 Target Decks in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes naturally on the way to the full set — keep answering Bret's texts as they arrive.
steps: As Jason after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), answer Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the unique animal he requests and bring it back to him.
Keep doing his Target Decks — the 100% checklist wants all 15.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, per PowerPyx, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them — so work on cards steadily and you will pass 3 sets long before 100%, without ever having to grind for this trophy alone. Cards are found across Leonida; PowerPyx links a full set-by-set location guide, so use it rather than wandering. Any 3 complete sets count, so finish the sets whose cards you already have most of first, and leave the scattered ones for the 100% push.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida until 3 full sets are complete.
Finish the sets you already have most of first; use PowerPyx's set-by-set location guide.
Keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Hold Up on the D-pad to open WAiNK instantly, then hold R1 on a scannable object. PowerPyx breaks the pool down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 count and you do not need a specific set. Scan everything you pass while playing: the same habit also feeds Whip It Good (scan 200 vehicles) and the 100% checklist's 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy is really a reward for looking around. If you are short late in the game, walk a dense area like Ocean Beach and scan every landmark and curiosity you pass.
steps: Open WAiNK (hold Up) and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you explore.
Any 100 scanned locations count — there are more than 100 in total.
The same habit feeds Whip It Good and the 100% checklist, so scan from the start.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy pops automatically on the way — you can skip the 10 hardest challenges entirely, and this trophy lets you skip 30 of them. View and track them under Progress > Challenges; a checkmark in the bottom-right corner shows which are done. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies, so leave this for late and then pick the easiest remaining ones: the list tells you exactly what each challenge asks, so sort by what you are already close to finishing rather than starting the hardest ones cold.
steps: Work on other trophies first — most challenges complete passively.
Late in the game, open Progress > Challenges and finish the 50 easiest.
Keep going to 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist; the 10 hardest can be skipped.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Then cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, and escape the red heat zone on a fast sports motorcycle; PowerPyx recommends driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not while you are still inside it. In practice you will likely get it automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level — so do not force it early if you would rather wait.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel helps.
It may also pop naturally during That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (call your partner with hold Right + Triangle). Loot 3 robbery targets in a row — green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time; the trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop, so if it does not pop, hit a fourth. PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. Wear an armored vest and carry Zombix/Adrenaline for healing, and keep moving between shops — lingering lets the wanted level fade, which breaks the chain.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level — the jewelry stores in north Vice City work well.
Wear an armored vest and carry Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; hit a fourth if it has not popped.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The easiest way, per PowerPyx: open the WAiNK app (hold Up), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; traffic gives you new models constantly. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy comes automatically if you scan from the start. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles, and use the WAiNK app to check whether a car is a base model you still need.
steps: Open WAiNK (hold Up) and scan vehicles — a busy road is the fastest spot.
Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive the vehicle.
Keep scanning to 200 base models for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Then line up 5 enemies and drop them quickly; PowerPyx suggests criminals at Gang Operations, an assault rifle like the Duke 556, and body armor from Ammu-Nation. Note that it reportedly does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick a gang fight. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by Focus Level 4 this is much easier, and it may pop naturally during the robbery grind.
steps: Buff focus (food/drink, Adrenaline) and raise Focus toward level 4.
Find a Gang Operation with several criminals grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down 5 criminals in one use.
Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by level 4 this is much easier.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport and take off. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — planes sitting on the airfield do not count. PowerPyx says the easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed, so keep flying straight and level until it appears. Expect a wanted level on the ground; move fast and do not stop to fight.
steps: Go to VCIA and find the passenger plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Board it via the stairs by the boarding bridge, reach the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away from the airport — the pop is slightly delayed.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. PowerPyx has a full route with screenshots; expect heavy resistance on the base, so be ready to fight your way in and out, and bring armor and snacks. Once you are in the tank, the hard part is over: the cannon does the rest, and you only need to use it in combat briefly.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County.
Enter through the gate (or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance).
Get into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good spot. Stay quiet and unseen throughout: if the alarm goes off or you are spotted, it does not count, so leave and try another store rather than fighting through. The Snap Gun also helps with the quiet approach in Retail Therapy.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun — do not kick the door.
Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, and leave unseen.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): it is marked automatically from story progress and introduces vault robberies — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry all the cash). After that quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans (finish his earlier quests first if needed — two Payday Loan robberies). Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so you will pass 5 on the way. A single vault can pay up to $205,000, making this the best endgame money — it also feeds Dime on the Dollar and the fencing totals.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4) to unlock vault robberies.
Bring your partner — hold Right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry all the cash.
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000 each) and rob 5 vaults, escaping each time.
Keep going to all 8 vaults for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest route is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is…: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and you will get this automatically while doing Maximum Withdrawal. To get it earlier, find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, so use a Pay 'n' Spray or get clear of the zone before relaxing.
steps: Either follow That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4) — the vault robbery counts.
Or blow open a roaming armored truck with a sticky bomb, then escape the heat radius.
The pop comes after the escape, not at the robbery itself.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest method, per PowerPyx, is to take a plane and fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do this after you have opened up the map through the story, and combine it with WAiNK scanning and vehicle spotting while you fly around — the same flight feeds You WAiNKer! and Whip It Good. Watch the map for black patches and sweep over them in a grid; small islands and the far corners are the ones people miss.
steps: Take a plane after the story has opened the map.
Fly over every fogged area until the map is fully revealed.
Check the corners and small islands — they are the patches people miss.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 Gang Operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes automatically on the way — you will have it long before the checklist is done. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed, and pick the gang with the fewest done when you want to finish this one off. Gang Operations are also a good place to attempt Gunslinger, since criminals group up there.
steps: Rob Illegal Operations (yellow map icons) until one per gang is done.
Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.
Keep going — all 39 are needed for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — KeenGamer lists it as 'exact trigger still being confirmed', and PowerPyx currently lists this trophy as unknown. What the official description pins down is the place and the act: Ocean Beach, a cocktail, a view. Try the beachfront bars and cafés along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and linger at a spot with a view over the water. If it does not pop, check back against the cited guides — this entry will be updated as players confirm the trigger. Do not trust any guide that claims a precise spot without a source; a specific bar name with no citation is a guess, not a method.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a beachfront bar or café with a view.
Order a cocktail there and stay at the viewpoint.
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — verify against the cited guides before retrying.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed — both KeenGamer and PowerPyx list this trophy's method as unknown as of the game's launch week. The description itself is the hint: take a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape. Try the vehicle showrooms around Vice City with a car already inside, and check the cited guides for a confirmed method as players pin it down. If a showroom's doors are locked, look for one with a car on display near the entrance; the trick is likely about exiting through the glass rather than the door.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City and drive a car out through the front.
The exact method is still unconfirmed — verify against the cited guides.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling — the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, one of the Gang Operations. PowerPyx gives the full method: go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (marked automatically), buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first, and inside take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while — go back and take what is left, so it is not missable.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
During Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2), take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe's contents.
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, not at the third item.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, per character (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership, and always go together with your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one character works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story. Strength rises slowly, so treat this as a background habit: work out whenever you are passing a gym, and check both characters' levels regularly.
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), buy a fitness club membership.
Work out with both characters together until both reach maximum Strength.
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon) to track each character.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.time: Comes naturally over the whole run
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. PowerPyx recommends turning on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action affects your reputation. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and finally Irredeemable — a permanent status to avoid, since cops become far more aggressive. Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this should come passively while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist; if it is still short at the end, PowerPyx notes you can farm it quickly, but keep the Irredeemable warning in mind — do not farm it by being needlessly violent.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally — robberies and encounters count toward 500.
Avoid pushing the profile to Irredeemable, which is permanent.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy as unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — but no guide has confirmed what, as of launch week. The honest advice is to play through the prologue's Payday Loans content, and if something fails once, try it again; then verify against the cited guides as players confirm the trigger. Do not trust a precise method that cites no source — the Payday Loans link is a lead from PowerPyx, not a confirmed method.
steps: Play the prologue's Payday Loans content; retry anything that fails once.
Method still unconfirmed — check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The unlock method is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy as unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The description suggests a strange, one-off event — the kind of thing that happens when you stumble into the game's UFO content. Explore Leonida's oddities and watch for UFO-related stranger content; as players confirm the questline, the cited guides will pin down the trigger. Until then, treat any exact method without a source as a guess, and keep an eye out for strange lights and stranger markers in the open world rather than grinding one spot.
steps: Look for UFO-related stranger content around Leonida.
Method still unconfirmed — verify against the cited guides.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed — KeenGamer notes it is a melee drive-by with the exact method unconfirmed, and PowerPyx believes it is from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The working method to try: ride a motorcycle, pull up alongside an enemy and kick them with a melee attack while moving, knocking them down. Repeat until it pops; if the kick alone does not trigger it, check the cited guides for the confirmed method as players pin it down. A quiet road with pedestrians is a safer practice spot than a gang fight.
steps: Ride a motorcycle and melee-kick enemies while driving past them.
Method still being confirmed — verify against the cited guides.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; you do not need to bring it at once. It comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock in Chapter 4 — so one good vault and a few bank jobs can nearly finish it.
steps: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then fence the marked bills — Yasmani in Vice City pays best.
Fence $250,000 in total; it is cumulative, not one trip.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money, per PowerPyx — they are the most expensive purchases. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, plus Pay 'n' Sprays. Spending counts across every shop type, and the 100% checklist's robbery and fencing work will leave you with plenty of cash to spend. If you are short at the end, buy a few high-end weapon attachments or a full car mod set — both count, and both are useful anyway.
steps: Spend $100,000 across any shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are fastest.
Robbery money from the 100% work covers it; buy weapon attachments or car mods if short.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties. (There are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count.) Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses: you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. All 8 cost $160,000 in total. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. The garages are not just a trophy: each one adds parking spots, which you need to register 10 vehicles for On the Spot, so buy them as soon as you can afford them.
steps: Finish Daily Driver (Chapter 2) to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the app.
The garages add parking spots you need for On the Spot.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses), and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots for more registrations. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down — the trophy counts registrations, not the value of the cars.
steps: Finish the Moses mission (Chapter 2) to get the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages for parking spots (see Little Boxes).
Drive 10 cheap stolen vehicles to Moses and choose Respray and Register.
